subject: Re: Early access API pass release — CloudBridge newsletter
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Early access API pass release proposal for CloudBridge newsletter

Hi Steph,

Following up from yesterday's sync — CloudBridge (newsletter audience ~12k devs) has asked if we can grant a small batch of time-limited API passes for an "early access" promotion tied to their June newsletter. They want to offer a bit of hands-on access (no billing card required) to a select cohort.

Proposal: 200 API passes, 14-day expiry from redemption, single-use per company, rate limit 60 requests/min per pass. We’d issue prefixed codes (CB-RED-YYYYMMDD-XXXX) and a short redemption landing page.

Attached: ea_pass_manifest.csv (sample codes batch) and distribution_guidelines.pdf (recommended guardrails).

Asks: 
- Approval to mint & issue the 200 codes
- Confirmation on expiry window and any special rate limits
- Ops contact to handle redemption telemetry and throttles (cc'ing Ben for ops handoff)

CloudBridge is a warm partner; if we greenlight this they may feature Redwood in their July partner roundup (marketing upside).

Thanks,
Marissa
--
Marissa Cole
Partner Growth | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Early access API pass release proposal for CloudBridge newsletter

Marissa — thanks for the clear write-up. A few quick questions before I sign off: 

1) Redemption telemetry: how will we map redemptions back to CloudBridge users? I want to ensure we can identify abuse quickly.
2) Quota & blast resilience: 200 passes might lead to a burst. Confirm whether autoscaling will cover 2x normal burst for the 14-day window or if we throttle via per-pass rate limits.
3) Legal/terms: do we need a shortened TOS acknowledgement at redemption (yes/no)?

Ben — can you confirm ops preparedness and whether the manifest format in the CSV matches our ingestion script? If not, can we get a 48-hour turnaround?

If answers are green, I can approve today.

-Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Early access API pass release proposal for CloudBridge newsletter

On Thu, Jun 18, 2026 at 10:03 AM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Marissa — thanks for the clear write-up. A few quick questions before I sign off: 

Quick answers: 
- Manifest format: the CSV looks mostly fine; I'll run it through the ingestion tool and return a sanitized batch the same day. Needs two header cols changed: "code"->"pass_code" and add "expires_at" (ISO). I can do that and reattach.
- Autoscaling: infra is set to handle short bursts, but to be conservative we'll enforce the 60 req/min per pass cap you proposed. If they unexpectedly promote beyond the cohort we can flip on a reserve pool but that needs lead time.
- Telemetry: redemption landing will capture the referrer + email if supplied. For newsletter redemptions we'll tag redemption_event.source=cloudbridge_newsletter and send an alert to #promo-redemptions on crossing 50 redemptions/day.

Also recommend a soft 7-day warning email to redemptions hitting 80% of their per-pass quota to avoid surprise throttles.

I'll prepare the sanitized CSV (ea_pass_manifest.cleaned.csv) and share in ~2 hours.

Ben
Ben Carter
Growth Ops | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Liam Carter <liam@cloudbridge.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 14:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Early access API pass release proposal for CloudBridge newsletter

Hi Marissa & team,

Thanks — CloudBridge is excited about this. A couple points from our side: 
- Our editorial team will include the redemption link in the July 1 newsletter; we expect most redemptions in the first 72 hours.
- Can passes be limited to one redemption per company email domain? That would help keep the trial for dev teams rather than individual testers.
- For marketing attribution, we need a UTM-parameter-friendly landing URL.

If you can confirm rate limits and expiry, we'll lock the copy today.

Best,
Liam
Liam Carter
Partnerships | CloudBridge Labs
liam@cloudbridge.io

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Liam Carter <liam@cloudbridge.io>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Early access API pass release proposal for CloudBridge newsletter

Folks — approving this now with the following guardrails in place: 
- Quantity: 200 passes (final sanitized CSV required from Ben)
- Expiry: 14 days from redemption
- Per-pass rate: 60 req/min; domain-based single redemption enforcement (ops will block duplicates from same corporate domain during redemption)
- Telemetry: redemption_event.source=cloudbridge_newsletter, alerts at 50/day to #promo-redemptions
- Landing page: marketing to include UTM params; Liam, we'll provide a UTM-ready URL: https://promos.redwood-inference.com/redeem?utm_source=cloudbridge&utm_medium=newsletter
- Legal: short acknowledgement on redemption ("By redeeming you accept Redwood's trial terms" with link). Legal has approved the short form.

Ben — please attach the cleaned manifest and pass values. Ops to ingest and schedule issuance by 24 hours prior to July 1 send.

Marissa — looping in marketing ops for the landing page and CS for standby on potential spikes. Once Ben posts the cleaned csv I'll close this thread.

Thanks,
Stephanie
Head of Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
